name: bling_erp-mcp
display_name: Bling ERP (BR integration hub — not a supplier) MCP
description: Bling ERP (BR integration hub — not a supplier) (ecommerce suppliers): me, list_products, get_produc

platform_mcp_bling_erp_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BLING_ERP_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_bling_erp_client_id.description: Client ID of your Bling app (Central de Extensões > Área do Integrador); sent with the client secret as HTTP Basic on the token request ('não é permitida a inserção destes parâmetros no body').

platform_mcp_bling_erp_client_secret.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BLING_ERP_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_bling_erp_client_secret.description: Client Secret of the same Bling app.

platform_mcp_bling_erp_refresh_token.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BLING_ERP_REFRESH_TOKEN
platform_mcp_bling_erp_refresh_token.description: refresh_token from a one-time authorization-code exchange (the code expires in 1 minute); valid 30 days. Access tokens last 6 hours (expires_in 21600) and are re-minted from it; a new refresh_token returned by Bling replaces the old one in memory, and with PLATFORM_MCP_STATE_DIR set it is also saved and preferred on the next start.

tools.name: me
tools.description: GET /empresas/me/dados-basicos: {data: {id, nome, cnpj, email, dataContrato}} of the connected Bling company.

tools.name: list_products
tools.description: GET /produtos: the products registered in YOUR Bling ERP (Bling is an ERP/integration hub, not a supplier) [{id, nome, codigo (SKU), preco, precoCusto, estoque.saldoVirtualTotal, tipo, situacao (A active / I inactive), imagemURL}]; `query` filters by nome, `category` is idCategoria. Prices are BRL. stock_balance is estoque.saldoVirtualTotal (a decimal).

tools.name: get_product
tools.description: GET /produtos/{idProduto}: full product with stock (estoque), default supplier (fornecedor {id, codigo, precoCusto, precoCompra}), dimensions and tax data.

tools.name: get_order
tools.description: GET /pedidos/compras/{idPedidoCompra}: a purchase order recorded in Bling (pedido de compra to a supplier) {id, numero, data, dataPrevista, total, fornecedor{id}, situacao{id, valor}, transporte, itens[], parcelas[]}. status_code is situacao.valor (0 em aberto, 1 atendido, 2 cancelado, 3 em andamento); `status` is left null because Bling returns a numeric code.
